title: Internal: split the monster compose test class
summary: Developer-facing cleanup: the ~5k-line J2clComposeSurfaceControllerTest is being broken up. Its shared test doubles now live in one reusable file, and the rich-text/annotation reply-submit tests moved into a focused per-flow test class. No production code or user-visible behavior changed; the same 182 tests still run and pass.

items: New UI (internal): extracted the shared compose test doubles (FakeGateway/FakeView/CapturingDeltaFactory/etc.) into ComposeTestDoubles so focused split test classes can reuse them, and moved the rich-text component reply-submit tests into a new J2clComposeRichComponentTest. Same coverage (182 tests), smaller, more navigable files.
